findings.evidence: template/scripts/managed_task.py:865–869 catches RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError and SystemExit around cleanup_validation_context, but excludes KeyboardInterrupt. An interruption during inner-receipt unlink or directory removal therefore escapes directly, leaving recovery state without the diagnostic containing cleanup-validation. The active delta requires failed cleanup to be reported explicitly, and docs/engineering/local-workspace.md promises that cleanup failures print an exact recovery command. tests/managed_task_exact_state_cases.py:test_final_cleanup_failures_retain_receipt_in_each_transition explicitly permits this bare KeyboardInterrupt.
findings.summary: A catchable interruption during cleanup leaves helper state without the required explicit cleanup error and recovery command.
